description: A three-player Sorcerer's Tower party combines Griffin Bulwark weaken, Furious Spear fury, Spike Shell thorns, and Retribution.
notes: Regal Sword is deliberately excluded because a successful parry redirects the hit and can prevent Griffin Bulwark weaken from applying.
The detailed trace protects active buffs and derived passive stats; final attacks protect thorns and retaliation damage.
